entities.name: Agnate
entities.description: Metathran general on Dominaria, twin of Thaddeus, who killed his brother at his wish and was killed by Grizzlegom after Dralnu's plague.

entities.name: Thaddeus
entities.description: Agnate's twin and fellow Metathran general, vivisected by Tsabo Tavoc.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Creator of the Metathran through the Bloodline project and leader of the army.

entities.name: Tsabo Tavoc
entities.description: Phyrexian who trapped and vivisected Thaddeus.

entities.name: Dralnu
entities.description: Lichlord who infected Agnate with plague.

entities.name: Grizzlegom
entities.description: Minotaur general who killed Agnate and destroyed Dralnu's minions.

entities.name: Orim
entities.description: Healer Agnate went to for treatment.

entities.name: Metathran
entities.description: Army created to fight the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Koilos
entities.description: Site of the most important battle of the Invasion's first stage.

entities.name: Vhelnish
entities.description: Underground city where Dralnu infected Agnate.

entities.name: Tolaria
entities.description: Place of time bubbles where the generals were kept.

events.summary: Agnate and Thaddeus are released from the Curtains of Time as the Invasion begins; Agnate collapses and Thaddeus revives him.
events.quote: Thaddeus used CPR to revive him

events.summary: The brothers attack Tsabo Tavoc's Phyrexians at Koilos in a pincer; Agnate fails while Thaddeus breaks through.
events.quote: Agnate's forces fared badly and were unable to force a breakthrough.

events.summary: Tavoc captures Thaddeus in a trap and Urza names Eladamri to replace him, who bests Agnate.
events.quote: Only after Eladamri had bested Agnate in combat

events.summary: Koilos is retaken; Agnate finds Thaddeus vivisected and ends his misery.
events.quote: Agnate fulfilled Thaddeus' last wish and ended his brother's misery.

events.summary: Grieving Agnate leaves with his troops to meet Dralnu at Vhelnish.
events.quote: Agnate even left the battlefield with all his Metathran troops to meet with Dralnu

events.summary: Dralnu infects Agnate with plague; Agnate asks Grizzlegom to kill him and take command; Grizzlegom destroys Dralnu's minions.
events.quote: Agnate asked Grizzlegom to kill him and take command of his armies

relations.quote: He was the twin brother of Thaddeus
The Metathran were created as part of Urza 's Bloodline project
The minotaur general fulfilled this wish
Dralnu had infused Agnate with his plague
